Iran Warns of Extended Conflict Amid US Threats

Iran has warned that any new war with the United States could last longer, with officials stating they would not announce attacks in advance. This comes after US President Trump claimed to have "knocked out much of Iran's military." Amid escalating threats from both the US and Israel, Iran has indicated it is exploring diplomacy. Reports also mention that over 100 Ukrainian drones targeted Russia overnight, damaging a major oil refinery, and that Russia hit a station in Dnipro as Ukraine warned of new strikes.
